notes.title: Update Notice(Ver.1.3.0)
notes.notes:
Ver.1.3.0 is now available for users on all platforms! 

Ver.1.3.0 Patch Notes
Please check the list of changes below for details on the main improvements and fixes in this patch.


 Updated the Online Manual
 Fixed some minor issues


We will continue to provide regular updates on future improvements and fixes as further details are finalized.

notes.title: Update Notice（Ver.1.2.1）
notes.notes:
The beta version(Ver.1.2.1) has be pushed to the live release version of the game.
Those who had switched to the beta version, please make sure to switch back to "None".

This patch includes the following fix:
・Fixed the issue with the game running at high speeds.

notes.title: Regarding Bug Fixes (2023/Oct/27)

Additional Information

notes.title: Ver. 1.2.1 Beta Update Notice
notes.notes:
We have released a beta update that resolves the abnormal speed issue. However, as this is a beta update there is a possibility that it may cause other issues to occur, and as such, we ask for your understanding. If this happens, please opt out of the beta and revert to the original release version.
Follow the steps below to opt into the beta.
[olist]
 Go to your Library from within the Steam Client and select “METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake”
 Right click and select “Properties”
  Select “Betas” and input "ecexea7MGp69" into the bar under "Private Betas" section.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/11a0ad4fa3a1ffe2e47477d63da3287eff642c5e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/a1e7523446bca8568b610066862346348d90e648.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/6e2c1837fc609372f640a3a2c2524f320fb55329.png
If successful, "Opt into: beta - beta test" will be displayed in blue underneath the bar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/251eb781d8aef7f624eb239a866db92ab4ed3e78.png
The option to select "beta" from the dropdown menu in "Beta Participation" will then become available.
Once selected, the beta update will download.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/8e69ea6ac8620ec357d760111c77b47520652124.png
You will be able to play the beta version once the download is complete.
To revert to the original release version, simply change “beta” back to “None” in the dropdown menu. Once the download reverting the beta update is complete, you will be able to play the original release version.
 For those who are tried and are using the temporary solution, make sure to reset the settings to the original settings first before launching the game.
[/olist]
